summaryZh: Briggs 实验室研究光合生物表型的化学基础，关注完整蛋白质状态与表型之间的关系。团队开发和应用肽质谱方法测量蛋白质组状态，并以系统生物学算法分析蛋白质组数据以发现表型调控机制。
researchQuestions: 光合生物表型的化学基础是什么？

evidence.quote: BRIGGS LAB The scientific focus of our research is to understand the chemical basis for phenotype in photosynthetic organisms. Our technical focus is on peptide mass spectrometry
By applying the algorithms and computational resources of systems biology to our proteome-wide datasets we discover mechanisms that regulate phenotype.
The scientific focus of our research is to understand the chemical basis for phenotype in photosynthetic organisms.
